shots.desc: Opening: wide set, pushes in to waist-up as she starts to sing
Waist-up, the camera arcs from her right to her left
Low angle from screen right, rises; she lifts her arm on the long note
Chest-up from screen right, drifts left
Finale: waist-up, pulls back and up to the whole set
Interlude: high crane shot from the right, comes down
Interlude: three-quarter close-up from the left, drifting
Interlude: low wide shot, slides sideways along the floor
Interlude end: long push in to chest-up, she starts the second verse
Waist-up, the camera arcs from her left to her right
Face close-up from screen left, slow push in
Low angle from screen left, rises; left arm opens
Chest-up from screen left, drifts right
Front: the last line, close-up slowly pulling back
Outro: crane from the left, rising over the stage
Outro: three-quarter close-up from the right, slow push in
Ending: pulls back to the whole set; final pose, then a bow
